title: lock claim
description: Lock a slot (worktree lock) OR a named shared resource like "browser" (atomic machine-level lock - claim BEFORE using the shared authenticated browser, release right after). wait=true queues until free; force=true steals. Losing a resource claim returns the holder.

task.description: optional short label stored in the lock

slot.description: which slot holds a resource (default: cwd auto-detect)

session.description: tmux session recorded in a slot's worktree lock
